findings.finding: Analytic shape distance, offline per-mask signed distance and final UV angular threshold are different representations; Goo primitive nodes do not automatically author a face threshold texture or detect bangs occlusion
For positive nonzero Size, sphere computes signed geometric distance with scale correction; circle usesxy; Linewidth makes a shell; Mask converts signed distance to scalar permission

findings.finding: Generator reads first channel>0 as binary, uses two distance grids, then interpolates ordered masks. A single scalar threshold cannot reproduce multiple lit/dark toggles of one pixel over one parameter interval
findings.limits: Monotonicity constraint is project analysis, not an explicit input validator in the author code

findings.finding: Integer distances,8-bit remapping/clamping and JPEG output are actual implementation choices; do not treat demo output as high precision control-data master. README display-gamma note is distinct from commented pow expression
